sections.Profile:
"Flying Chariots" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1963. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, five passive bumpers, two slingshots, and three targets.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
